entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I had noticed traces of tampering. Does[n]that mean you truly took the data from[n]my laptop?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: No matter how I think about it, that[n]would've been impossible unless[n]Makoto was helping you...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But... she would never do something[n]so foolish...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And is it true that you were completely[n]uninvolved with the Kobayakawa case?
It's true.
We had nothing against him.
We don't kill.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What does this mean...?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But I suppose targeting someone at[n]Shujin again and actually taking their[n]life would be nonsensical.
That's right.
Will you believe me now?
I'm not lying to you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I have no reason to believe everything[n]you've said.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...However, it seems you aren't the type[n]of person who would lie just to protect[n]themselves.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I will acknowledge what I must. It's more[n]efficient that way.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...In any case, let's move on to the topic[n]at hand.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If you saw my investigation data,[n]you would've had the same suspicions[n]I did about Okumura.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And if you looked into his Palace,[n]you should've seen the answer to[n]those suspicions.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Tell me. What did the Phantom Thieves[n]do to Okumura? What did you learn[n]from him?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Why did it turn out as it did?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I need you to tell me everything.
I feel like my bond with Sae[n]is growing deeper...
entries.uk: Здається, мій зв'язок із Сае[n]стає глибшим...
